about.heroTitle: Everyday shopping should be fast, effortless, and premium. We built Supermarche so you get instant doorstep delivery.
about.heroSubtitle: The premier online supermarket and lifestyle store in Cameroon — express delivery for fashion, shoes, cosmetics, electronics, fresh groceries, and everyday snacks.
about.storyLeft: Supermarche started with a simple vision: online shopping in Cameroon should be instant, reliable, and delightful.
about.storyP1: Finding quality apparel, authentic footwear, skincare essentials, electronics, and daily groceries used to take hours of navigating busy markets.
about.storyP2: We curated an all-in-one digital supermarket featuring trending fashion, footwear, beauty glow kits, smart audio accessories, organic produce, and express home delivery.
about.storyP3: Today, Supermarche operates across major hubs in Cameroon, delivering express orders directly to homes, offices, and neighborhood residences.
about.p1Desc: Every item is verified, quality-checked, and carefully packaged before dispatch.
about.p2Desc: What you see is what you pay. No hidden surcharges, clear pricing on every item.
about.p3Desc: Rapid delivery straight to your doorstep or location with instant Mobile Money payment.
about.p4Desc: Tailored around how people here shop, pay, and get quality items delivered effortlessly.
about.ctaTitle: Want to build this with us?
about.ctaSubtitle: We're always looking for energetic partners and creative minds.

pro.title: Turn Your Trade & Transport Skills into Daily Mobile Earnings
pro.subtitle: Join Cameroon's premier verified service provider network. Accept gas dispatches, market errands, and repair work orders directly on your phone with instant MoMo payouts.
pro.ctaTitle: Earn Steady Income as a Verified Service Provider
pro.ctaSubtitle: Are you a skilled technician, market procurement agent, or gas delivery expert in Cameroon? Join hundreds of active service providers getting daily dispatched jobs.
pro.card1Desc: Receive instant transfers to your MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money account immediately after completing client jobs.
pro.card2Desc: Choose your active availability hours and accept job dispatches in Bastos, Bonapriso, Molyko & Nkwen.
pro.card3Desc: Gain client trust with verified Supermarche provider badges, safety insurance coverage, and priority dispatch queues.
pro.whyJoinTitle: Why Join the Supermarche Provider Network?
pro.whyJoinSub: Built specifically for skilled tradespeople, logistics runners, and service specialists across Cameroon cities.
pro.benefit1Desc: Direct transfers into your MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money account immediately after client work verification.
pro.benefit2Desc: Turn your provider availability ON or OFF whenever you want. Work full-time or take extra side dispatches.
pro.benefit3Desc: Gain client confidence in premium quarters (Bastos, Bonapriso, Molyko) with verified Supermarche provider credentials.
pro.benefit4Desc: 24/7 dedicated dispatch desk support and job guarantee protection for all approved provider work orders.
pro.stepsTitle: How to Become a Supermarche Service Provider in 3 Easy Steps
pro.stepsSub: Simple registration process designed to get you verified and taking jobs fast.
pro.step1Desc: Fill out your full name, phone number, city hub (Yaoundé, Douala, Buea, Bamenda), and primary skill category.
pro.step2Desc: Our team verifies your National ID (CNI) and confirms your active Mobile Money payment details.
pro.step3Desc: Open your Supermarche Mobile Provider app, set your availability to active, and start accepting paid job tickets.
pro.faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions for Service Partners
pro.faqSub: Everything you need to know about joining Supermarche as a verified technician or runner.
pro.modalTitle: Apply to Join Supermarche Provider Network
pro.modalSub: Fill out your details below to start receiving verified customer dispatches in your city.
pro.successMsg: Application Submitted Successfully! Our operations team will contact you within 24 hours.
pro.whatsappHelper: Formatting recommendation: +237 prefix for WhatsApp verification
pro.addSkillPlaceholder: Search & add skill category (e.g., Cooking Gas, Plumbing...)
pro.confirmationGuaranteeDesc: Expect a direct message via {{channel}} within 48 hours to confirm document verification.
pro.faq1Q: What qualifications do I need to join as a Supermarche service pro?
pro.faq1A: You need a valid National ID (CNI) or passport, an active Mobile Money account, and demonstrated experience in your trade (gas safety, market procurement, cleaning, or repairs).
pro.faq2Q: How and when do I receive payment for completed jobs?
pro.faq2A: Payouts are transferred instantly to your MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money account as soon as the client confirms task completion and safety verification.
pro.faq3Q: Is there a registration or membership fee to join?
pro.faq3A: No, joining the Supermarche provider network is completely free. We only deduct a transparent service commission per completed job ticket.
pro.faq4Q: Which cities are currently active for provider dispatches?
pro.faq4A: Active provider dispatches are live across all major districts in Yaoundé, Douala, Buea, and Bamenda.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about shopping, tracking orders, paying with Mobile Money, and returns.
faq.q1: How does doorstep delivery work for Kim's Store orders?
faq.a1: Orders are processed immediately and dispatched via our dedicated express delivery runners. You receive real-time notifications and can track delivery directly on your dashboard.
faq.q2: What happens if an item or size is out of stock?
faq.a2: Our team promptly notifies you with suitable replacement alternatives or processes an instant Mobile Money refund per your preference.
faq.q3: Which cities and neighborhoods are currently covered in Cameroon?
faq.a3: Currently delivering across all districts in Yaoundé, Douala, Buea, and Bamenda, with regional expansions underway.
